items.title: Tyner McCoy — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Alphonse leaves your group and you have Wilby Fletcher for a minute

ctx.x: Yes, Wilby passed recently, but you also liked Wilby a lot.
Yeah he’s featured on Atlantis. So he had to come behind Alphonse . . . I mean that’s a hard act to follow, I know.
